dt_edits.value: Cover every square within 2 of you, your own included, in ice. Deals no damage.
Freeze an ally solid: fully restore their HP and make them invincible, but they cannot act for 1 turn.
Increases damage dealt by Icy Breath.
Increases the range of Cold Compress by 1.
Decreases TP cost of Icy Breath by 1.
Increases the range of Cryostasis by 1.
A researcher at Hyzante's Ministry of Medicine who would rather study what he likes. Ice in his hands is medicine.
